note: Writes data\game\game<n>.dat for a named slot: 0x2880-byte world block, level index and name, player health and magic, inventory, hotkey icons.

name: GAME_LoadGame
note: Reads a slot back, reloads its level record from DREAMS.DAT by name, reattaches the inventory to the player and starts the level load with a 15-frame fade.

name: GAME_SaveThumbnail
note: Renders a 64x64 frame of the scene and writes it as data\game\game<n>.ico, then restores the viewport.

name: DAN_Load3DA
note: Finds a .3DA name in the open DAN archive's 13-byte directory and LZ_Unpacks it; RES_ReadFile routes .3DA here.

name: AI_TickCombat
note: Per-member melee combat decision.

name: STRM_Open
note: Opens a file on the 0x2c-byte ring-buffer stream: closes the old fd, _uopen_, resets positions, allocates twice the buffer size from the MEM stack at 0x5df484. Returns 1/0.

name: STRM_Commit
note: Consumes the count set by STRM_Peek: advances the read position with wrap, updates available/free, clears flag bit 1 (& 0xfd).

name: GAME_InitSubsystems
facts: str:data\hnm\; str:\hnm\; str:Dreams Internal Error : ; call:0003c2c8
note: Game-side start-up: event queue, INPUT_Init, main handler, sound, audio CD, optional intro.

name: DSN_Create3DM
note: In DSN mode a .3DM texture is built, not read: finds the name in the DSN 11-byte table, copies the 20-byte header template, zeroes a 0x8000 palette block and a 0x10000 page at +0x8014, returns 0x18014. DSN_LoadTextures fills it.

name: ENT_SpawnTrailParticles
note: Emits one or two particles into the 64-entry trail ring from the actor's position and velocity (lifetime 1000).

name: ENT_SpawnHitParticle
note: Takes a slot in the 16-entry hit-particle ring and places it at the actor with random jitter scaled by its radius.

name: ENT_FindNearbyPickup
note: Finds the first collectable actor within 200 units of the player (skipping walkers and removed ones) and returns it.

name: ENT_TickPlayerGround
note: Ground controller: landing damage and knock-down from the last fall speed, slot keys 1/2/3 (select, cast), pick-up, jumps, take-off into flight, walking, stepping back, and the combat-stance attack chains.

name: ENT_TickPlayerSwimming
note: Swimming controller: arrows 0x24/0x26/0x3d/0x3c, Alt picks up and plays 6 or 7, flight-capable forms fire with Ctrl.

name: ENT_TickPlayerFlying
note: Flying controller: drains magic by 0.04 per frame-time unit; out of magic or on a hard impact requests 0xe, which ends the flight (mode 1, airborne, state 0x19, downward speed 20/dt); arrows 0x24/0x26/0x3d/0x3c.

name: ENT_TickPlayerControl
note: Per-frame player control: enemy scan and combat stance (800/1500/2500 by weapon, 60-unit hold), then the ground, swimming or flying controller by mode +0x34; with Insert held the arrows become look keys.

name: FILE_SeekOrDie
note: lseek_, fatal "Seek file Error" on failure.

name: SPR_LoadPortrait
note: Builds the picture sprite 0x49ff26 from a TABLE blob in memory.

name: CD_PromptSwap
facts: str:Please change to CD no %; str:DATA\1CD.ID; str:DATA\2CD.ID; call:0003c2c8
note: Shows "Please change to CD no %d" and polls until DATA\1CD.ID or DATA\2CD.ID opens.

name: ENT_AddInventoryItem
note: Adds a named object to the actor's 32-slot inventory (+0x30): counts a repeat, else takes the first empty slot; posts UI message 0x41.

name: ENT_BeginTransform
note: Starts the transformation (alternate actor takes over)

name: MENU_DrawSpellPage
note: Draws the spell tab.

name: MENU_RunGameMenu
note: Main loop of the game menu.

name: BOOT_TickFrame
note: Per-frame boot/menu step, 40 ms ticks.

name: MENJ_PlayVoiceCaptions
note: Voice message with synchronized captions and portrait; Again/exit.

name: PHYS_InitEntity
note: Level-load physics setup: position, zero velocity and force, mass 1.0 (10.0 for free objects), damping factor 1.0; walkers get an actor collider, free objects an object collider, platform sets their platforms.

name: PHYS_BuildPlatforms
note: For an entity flagged +0xad bit 8, makes each child node a platform (at most 64) with half-extents from its vertices and a radius.

name: PHYS_UpdatePlatforms
note: Per tick: moves the platform root, then for each platform its world position, frame delta (+0x14), top and box (+-half-extent in X/Z, +-200 in Y).

name: ENT_InitShadows
facts: str:Dreams Internal Error : ; str:data\3dc\ombre.3dc; str:data\3dc\ombre2.3dc; call:00071318
note: Loads data\3dc\ombre.3dc and ombre2.3dc (ombre = shadow) and makes 16 instances of each in the 0x48-byte shadow table at 0x62b51c.

name: ENT_UpdateShadow
note: Places the actor's shadow (slot +0x2c4) 10 units above the floor Y (+0x88), aligned to the floor triangle's normal and the heading.

name: ENT_MoveAttackObject
note: Moves/homes an attack object.

name: ENT_ApplyDamage
note: Applies damage (victim EAX, attacker EDX, amount EBX)

name: ENT_TakeDamage
note: Subtracts a float amount from health (+0x38; scaled when the action is 0x2b), spawns four hit particles, plays a sound, sets the 50,000 hurt timer (+0x114); at zero requests death (0x33 swimming, else 0x32).

name: ENT_TakeDamageQuiet
note: ENT_TakeDamage without the hit particles; used for the two lightest landing damages.

name: HNM5_DecodeFrame640
note: HNM5 IV chunk decoder.

name: MDL_RelocPrimitives
note: Relocates a linked list of typed primitive blocks; element records stride 0x44 (0x38 for types -2, 1, 4, 0x11, 0x1b).

name: MDL_BindTreeMaterials
note: Walks the node tree (child +0x14, sibling +0x18, parent +0x10) and binds each node's face-block list (+0xa4) to the material cache.

name: MDL_RelocCollision
note: Relocates the .3DI collision mesh (resource type 5): header pointers +4/+0xc/+0x14, then each 0x60-byte triangle's +0/+4/+8 vertex, +0xc normal and +0x44 pointers.

name: REND_SetViewportFocal
note: Viewport with an explicit focal length scaled by w/640 (the portrait render), centre, near 128, far 65000.

name: REND_SetViewportFov
note: Viewport from a horizontal FOV: focal K = 0.5 + (w/2)/tan(fov/2); centre (x + w/2, y + h/2); near 128, far 65000. The game always passes 76.36 degrees.

name: REND_UpdateFrustum
note: Builds and normalises the four side-plane normals (0x661e54/68/74/84) from the focal lengths and viewport, plus the depth scale terms 0x661e60/64.

name: MDL_SetNodeRotation
note: Looks up a node by handle and copies a 3x3 Q15 matrix into its local rotation (+0x28); handle 0 is the camera.

name: MDL_SetNodePosition
note: Sets node position; camera nodes also recompute the inverse translation.

name: ANIM_ApplyModelLinear
note: Applies a linear-key animation (or a blend of two) to every node of a model.

name: ANIM_EvalTrackSpline
note: Evaluates a spline (TCB/Hermite) track: rotation keys 0x3c, position keys 0x30.

name: MATH_BuildOrientMatrix
note: Builds a Q15 rotation matrix from a unit direction and a roll angle (4096-entry sine and cosine tables at 0x665ff0/0x669ff0).

name: MATH_NormalizeVec3
note: Normalises an integer vector to Q15 length.

name: MATH_CopyVec3
note: Copies three ints.

name: MATH_QuatToMatrix
note: Fixed-point quaternion to Q15 3x3 matrix.

note: CryoLib HNM6 decoder linked into the game; see docs/cryolib.md.

name: HNM6_Init_All_15

note: CryoLib HNM6 decoder linked into the game; see docs/cryolib.md.

name: PHYS_InsertMeshTriangles
note: Adds each triangle's min and max endpoints to the three per-axis sorted arrays and re-sorts them.

name: PHYS_SweepAxis
note: Incremental sweep-and-prune on one axis: moves the collider's interval (centre +-radius) through the sorted triangle bounds (+0x48 min, +0x54 max), adding and removing candidates.

name: PHYS_AllocCollider
note: Allocates and initialises a 0x38-byte collider, at most 255 per world.

name: PHYS_GetEdgeDistance
note: Signed distance of a point from triangle edge plane i (normal +0x14 + 12i, constant +0x38 + 4i).

name: PHYS_ProjectOntoPlane
note: Closest point for a face contact: the point projected onto the triangle plane.

name: PHYS_FindClosestOnSegment
note: Closest point on an edge segment, clamped to its ends.

name: PHYS_TestTriangleVertical
note: Floor test: side filter, point-in-triangle in XZ, rejects walls (normal Y 0); returns the plane point under the centre, 1 above or -1 below.

name: PHYS_CollideSphereTriangle
note: Sphere vs triangle: plane band by side flags, edge planes classify face, edge or vertex; returns +-2 face, +-1 edge or vertex (sign = side).

name: PHYS_CreateCollider
note: Creates a collider (sphere) in the collision world with a side-flags byte.

name: PHYS_DestroyCollider
note: Removes a collider from the collision world.

name: PHYS_UpdateCollider
note: Runs the sweep-and-prune update on all three axes and resets the candidate iterators.

name: PHYS_SetColliderRadius
note: Sets a collider's radius (+0xc) when positive.

name: PHYS_GetTriangle
note: Copies a triangle's vertices and normal; returns +0x18 of the mesh it belongs to.

name: PHYS_GetCollider
note: Returns a collider's centre, radius and flags.

name: REND_CullObjectSphere
note: Tests the node's bounding sphere (+0xb0) against four frustum planes and the near/far depths; sets +0x0c bits 8 (outside), 0x20, 0x40 (crosses near/far).

name: REND_ComputeNormalDots
note: For each 16-byte face normal (+0x98, count +0x94) stores n . eye in its fourth word, the value REND_CullFaces compares with the face's plane distance.

name: REND_ClipFaceNear
note: Splits a face with one or two vertices behind the near plane (outcode 0x10) into new faces with interpolated UVs, pushed on the block's visible list.

name: REND_CullFaces
note: Per face block: visible list = records; back-face test (normal eye_dot - face +0x30) and outcode rejection; near-crossing faces go to REND_ClipFaceNear, the rest flag their vertices 0x40.

name: REND_LightObject
note: Per-object lighting: light attenuation, flat/Gouraud shades.

name: REND_ComputeEnvMapUVs
note: Sphere environment mapping: each visible face's UVs become the view-space corner normal scaled to texels, centred on 128.0 (0x800000). Runs when node +0x0d bit 8 is set.
